metadataFragmentRow.description: When Product-metadata lives on a separate fragment URL (not next to this block), add a row: first cell metadata-fragment (or metadata-src), second cell the path to the fragment, e.g. /fragments/products/delo-syn-trans-xe-sae-75w-90

note: Sibling Product-metadata still merges; fragment fetch runs first, then sibling values override by key.
